subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, F, G, H, I, J, K and R, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. I sits third to the left of J. R sits second to the left of G. Only J sits between H and R. F is not an immediate neighbour of I. How many people sit between K and R when counted from the right of K?
solution:
Seven people, F, G, H, I, J, K and R, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

 
• I sits third to the left of J.
 
• R sits second to the left of G.
 
• Only J sits between H and R.
 
• F is not an immediate neighbour of I
